verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents a broad API v2 that covers its core file-processing features: conversion jobs with import and export tasks, optimize, watermark, website capture, thumbnails, merge, archive, metadata, custom commands and AI tasks. It also offers official SDKs, OAuth and scoped API keys. Nothing states that the API matches everything the UI can do, and account-level functions are not shown as API-accessible: region is set via region-specific endpoints or in account settings, and billing, auto-refill, team and subscription management have no API evidence. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account settings, billing, team and subscription management, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: For API v2, official PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Java and .NET SDKs are available.
the first task of a job could import a file from an S3 bucket. The second task could convert this file... the final task of the job could export the file back to an S3 bucket.
Create a task to create a ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ or TAR.BZ2 archive.
Add a watermark to a PDF file, to an image (PNG, JPG...) or to a video (MP4, MOV...).
You can use a specific region by using the region-specific endpoints or setting a fixed region in your account settings.
